declarations.docstring: A family of types indexed by a natural number.
An element of the indexed target associated with a finite index.
The product of the indexed element and its displayed companion is one.
A second indexed element of the target type.
Assigns a complex number to an integral exponent and a target element.
Evaluating the displayed product at a summed exponent equals a complex scalar times another evaluation.
Produces a target element from an integral exponent and a complex number.
The product of two displayed exponent elements combines their exponents by addition and their complex inputs by multiplication.
Raising the exponent element with complex input one to a natural power scales its exponent.
A finite product of displayed exponent elements with complex input one equals the element at the summed exponent.
The exponent element at zero with complex input one is one.
Equates the displayed partition-and-permutation expression with an application of the complex-valued function.
Equates a displayed complex-valued function application with a signed multivariate-polynomial coefficient.
A complex multivariate polynomial for each natural-number index.
The indexed polynomial is a scalar multiple, by the displayed permutation sign, of another polynomial.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type is unavailable.
Applying the complex-valued function after the displayed polynomial map equals the corresponding polynomial coefficient.
An additive monoid homomorphism from natural-valued to integer-valued finitely supported functions.
The exponent homomorphism acts pointwise by casting each natural value to an integer.
The displayed exponent homomorphism is injective.
A target element for each natural-number index.
The displayed exponent element equals an iterated finite product of indexed elements.
The displayed mapped exponent equals a finite sum of singleton finitely supported functions weighted by upper-index cardinalities.
Multiplying the displayed exponent element by the indexed target element equals the image of the indexed polynomial under the displayed map.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type is unavailable.
A ring homomorphism from complex multivariate polynomials to the indexed target.
The ring homomorphism sends a polynomial variable to the corresponding indexed element.
The displayed ring homomorphism is injective.
